title: HTTP client and DEHU writer hardening before
result: cookies scoped to a public suffix or a foreign domain are dropped; redirects to another host outside the administrations are refused; responses and undeclared decompression are capped at 64 MiB; DEHU file names are sanitised and writes outside `--out` are refused.
evidence: `pnpm check:ci` 461 files and 1023 tests passing; live `cirbe estado` and `dehu list` through the new redirect check.
